title: canonical-request-csv/1 — one row
description: Recoup's own CSV format a customer can produce from any log source. Header row required: timestamp,status_code,error_class,resource_id,request_id.

error_class.description: service_internal = the AWS service's own error. A 5xx row marked 'unknown' can't be classified, so the claim stays unproven (README, evidence rules).

resource_id.description: For API Gateway: the API ID.
